body: A couple of things to sort before merge, inline.

comments.body:
CR: Without a `status` param the query filters on `status IS NULL`, so the export is empty. I'd apply the filter only when the param is present.

```suggestion
        $orders = Order::query()->when($request->filled('status'), fn ($q) => $q->where('status', $request->input('status')))->get();
```
FFT: Each row reads the customer relation, one query per order. I'd load it with Order::with('customer').
